description: Strategy learnings extracted from YouTube trader transcripts. Organized by source and asset class. Used to improve rules.json.

key_strategies_extracted: STK-1: Bull Flag / Micro Pullback — momentum day trade on gapping stocks
STK-2: VWAP Reclaim Reversal — buy when price reclaims VWAP with volume
STK-3: Moving Average Bounce — 9 EMA dip buy in strong uptrend
key_indicators_learned: EMA 9 as primary intraday support (buy dips here)
VWAP as bull/bear control line (new — not in original rules)
MACD 12,26,9 as window open/closed binary filter
Dual 200 EMA + 200 SMA on daily chart (professionals vs beginners)
10-second chart for precision entries during parabolic moves
key_risk_rules_learned: Profit Cushion system: start 1/4 size, scale up after 1/4 daily goal reached
Adding to winners: double position, move stop to breakeven
Never add to losers — cut immediately
Front side only: trade first spike + first 2 pullbacks
MACD crossover = stop trading that stock entirely
key_psychology_learned: Track consecutive discipline days, not consecutive green days
30-minute inactivity rule — walk away if no setup found
Hot market: trade longer. Cold market: walk away early
Decision fatigue awareness — quality drops with time
Sim trade 90 days minimum before real money
